d: US President Donald Trump has always hated the OPEC oil cartel. But a new report says that this year, he has actively been trying to dismantle OPEC, by targeting two of its founding members. US officials have reportedly held meetings with the leaders of both Venezuela and Iraq, to try and convince the nations to exit the bloc. Firstpost looks at what the US has been doing to undermine OPEC. Hem Kaur Saroya explains why Venezuela and Iraq have not left OPEC yet. HKS also looks at how OPEC manages to control oil prices across the world, and what Trump's moves mean for the cartel.
